candidates.name: OGC MUDDI
verified_facts: MUDDI defines classes for integrating datasets describing underground space, including utility infrastructure, soils, groundwater and other subsurface information.
Its conceptual model supports reuse of information from different underground-domain models.
semantic_limits: Subsurface-model geometry or depth attributes are not a substitute for an inland bare-earth surface DTM or a parcel-specific terrain elevation measurement.

candidates.name: OGC CDB Version 2 Core
verified_facts: OGC CDB Version 2 Core defines a standardized model and structure for a versionable virtual representation of the earth and large geospatial content repositories.
The CDB datastore supports interoperable applications including simulation and analysis domains.
semantic_limits: A CDB-compliant datastore structure does not certify that its terrain content is an authoritative survey, current bare-earth DTM, correct vertical datum or parcel-specific measurement source.
